verdict.rationale: Undermind explicitly runs autonomous multi-step deep literature reviews from an open-ended research goal, planning its own searches, following citations/authors, and stopping only when searches stop finding new relevant papers, producing a ranked list and synthesis — clearly beyond single-pass summarization. Community hands-on reports corroborate deep, time-intensive (minutes-long) autonomous searches finding papers users missed via Google Scholar, though some note gray literature/dissertation gaps. Missing for 10: independent verification of the full 'stops only when exhaustive' claim and more detailed benchmarking against other multi-step research agents.
